models.mechanism: The recurring span is imagined as an active press: its passage applies pressure and thereby draws out a latent yield. The packet supplies time, pressing, and extracted gain; the causal operation joining them is inferred.

activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies the temporal medium that repeatedly acts
supplies the mechanism of pressure and extraction
supplies the result drawn out by the temporal press

structural_cues: The oath wāw and genitive noun present al-ʿaṣr as the thing invoked as evidence.
The focus is a single compact oath expression; no affected object or product is stated.

abductive_moves.assumption: The oath selects time for what it does, not merely for calendrical identification.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: Nothing in the focus explicitly turns duration into pressure or names a product; the assumption lets the three root branches form an operative chain.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies time, pressing, and yield; I infer time-as-pressure → extraction of latent yield.
alternatives: The noun may mean age, afternoon, or recurring time without a pressing metaphor.
Pressing and yield may remain unrelated lexical senses here.

changed_reading.before: A bare oath by time or an age.
changed_reading.after: An oath by time as a pressure that exposes and extracts what things contain.

models.ablation: Without B002 the operative pressure disappears; without B007 the model becomes a generic metaphor of strain rather than extraction.

models.mechanism: A span of time is imagined as a protective enclosure: like a husk or refuge, it holds vulnerable becoming until a threshold of maturity is reached. The packet supplies enclosure, refuge, and maturity, but not their developmental sequence.

activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies the interval within which development occurs
makes the interval protective rather than merely restrictive
provides the containing form that preserves an interior
provides the maturation threshold toward which the enclosure holds

structural_cues: The oath construction foregrounds the time-noun itself rather than stating a predicate about it.
No explicit sequence or second root appears in the one-word focus, so enclosure → preservation → maturity is not textually asserted.

abductive_moves.assumption: Enclosure during a time-span preserves developing contents and enables maturation.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: B005, B010, and B009 name compatible roles but the packet does not say that refuge or husk causes development.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies temporal interval, refuge, enclosure, and maturity; I infer protective enclosure over time → preserved development → maturity.
alternatives: The oath may invoke time with no container image.
The refuge, husk, and maturation branches may be independent senses without a shared process.

changed_reading.before: A bare oath by elapsed or recurring time.
changed_reading.after: An oath by time as a sheltering interval that contains growth until it ripens.

models.ablation: Remove B010 and the enclosure becomes generic refuge; remove B009 and the model loses its developmental destination.

surprise_reading: At this focus-only baseline, “By al-ʿaṣr” can provisionally evoke duration as an active medium: either a press that extracts latent yield or a sheltering enclosure that holds growth until maturity. Both remain tentative because the focus supplies only one root and states neither causal chain.
